tool_arguments.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: neutral creature model-sheet front reference for an original webtoon. Native canvas 1536x1024 landscape PNG. One creature only, orthographic full-body FRONT view, camera level with its chest, no perspective distortion. Soft neutral key light from upper left. Flat light-grey #E9E9EC background edge to edge, empty background, no gradient, texture or vignette, only tiny soft contact shadows at the paws. No person, no silhouette, no scale marks, no inset, no lettering. The creature fills about 86% of the canvas height with all ears, paws and tail safely inside the image.

Subject: a dangerous drowned hound, an enormous quadrupedal canine with correct dog skeleton and joints; 1.7 m at the shoulder and 3.5 m long, a gaunt elongated torso, prominent ribs and hips, deep narrow chest and heavy bony shoulders, long weight-bearing legs, large bony canine paws, a long heavy jaw and muzzle. Front feet planted with rear paws visible behind them at natural spacing, not a biped. Long low-hanging tail and drooping pointed ears. Its mouth is slightly parted to show irregular crooked yellow teeth without gore. Two pale clouded eyes remain visible; a SINGLE SMALL black-violet #1A1026 hairline crack on the central brow emits a few discrete violet ash #6B4C9A flecks. Never a face-hole, large forehead crystal, glowing eyes, horns, fins or spikes. Waterlogged near-black charcoal fur hangs down under gravity in a small number of large matted wet clumps, NOT fluffy, not hundreds of sawtooth strands. Selective crisp grey-blue wet glints only; fur remains primarily flat inked colour with one broad cool cel-shadow. Sparse attached river-weed strands in muted olive, small irregular barnacle clusters on the flanks and shoulder sides; these are visible at the sides of the frontal silhouette, not armour. Water drips in a few thin drawn streams from muzzle, belly and limbs; no large puddle or environmental water on this sheet. Make the long heavy skull and emaciated silhouette immediately legible at phone size. Construction is hand-inked and cel-coloured, not painterly or photoreal. All four limbs anatomically distinct; canine paws have four weight-bearing toes and small claws, not human fingers.

The drowned hound: a gaunt, heavy-boned hound the size of a horse, 1.7 m at the shoulder, with waterlogged black fur hanging in wet clumps, river weed and barnacles on its flanks, a long jaw of crooked yellow teeth, pale clouded eyes, water streaming off it, and a small crack on its brow leaking violet ash.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
